      Name

      Dismeigh. Pronounced like “dismay.” Always one word, capital D.

      Short bio

      Dismeigh (pronounced like “dismay”) is a Cowboy Bebop-flavored VTuber, car enthusiast, voice actor and creative developer streaming on Twitch since 2021.

      Long bio

      Dismeigh (pronounced like “dismay”) is a VTuber, car enthusiast, voice actor and creative developer streaming on Twitch since June 2021. Streams bounce between games, garage talk about the Sojourn ST (a modded 2014 Focus ST) and whatever chaos chat brings, all wrapped in a Cowboy Bebop look. As a voice actor, Dismeigh voices Sir Ian in the animated series Alvion. Off stream, Dismeigh builds websites and Discord servers through Denizen Technologies.
